## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
RISK-OFF, as supplied. Breadth: 0/11 sectors positive; confirmation comes from universal sector weakness and both Financials and Industrials posting negative 1W returns. Leadership: Broad by the Top 5 performers’ sector spread (4 sectors), but the gains are selective and mostly short-term rebounds.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Relative leaders—not positive sectors—are Communication, Consumer Staples and Utilities, with 1W returns of -2.71%, -2.73% and -4.31%, respectively. TGT ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.71% | 1M: +5.62%) and KHC ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.12% | 1M: +1.20%) show Staples resilience; DUK ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.48% | 1M: +4.37%) leads Utilities.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Technology is weakest at -13.10% for 1W and -18.76% for 1M; NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -22.92% | 1M: -40.85%) and ORCL BELOW TREND (1W: -19.27% | 1M: -19.40%) underscore the pressure. Materials (-8.11% 1W) and Energy (-7.87% 1W) also lag; FCX BELOW TREND (1W: -22.37% | 1M: -28.80%) and XOM BELOW TREND (1W: -5.62% | 1M: -9.67%) confirm weakness.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: PANW RECOVERY (1W: +6.54% | 1M: -3.27%), TJX RECOVERY (1W: +3.91% | 1M: -4.93%), TGT ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.71% | 1M: +5.62%), KHC ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.12% | 1M: +1.20%) and T RECOVERY (1W: +0.59% | 1M: -1.89%). Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5); note that two of the strongest weekly moves remain below their 1M returns.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: NEM BELOW TREND (1W: -16.32% | 1M: -17.03%), UNH BELOW TREND (1W: -16.59% | 1M: -20.03%), CRM BELOW TREND (1W: -17.09% | 1M: -27.84%), AMAT BELOW TREND (1W: -18.20% | 1M: -19.30%) and LRCX BELOW TREND (1W: -18.88% | 1M: -20.37%). Weakness is concentrated in Technology, with additional pressure in Healthcare and Materials.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Best 1W momentum: PANW (1W: +6.54% | 1M: -3.27%) and TJX (1W: +3.91% | 1M: -4.93%), both RECOVERY patterns rather than confirmed trend reversals. Major divergence is present across several large-cap names; monitor for trend breaks rather than treating short-term rebounds as established leadership.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Technology is weakest, with sector returns of -13.10% for 1W and -18.76% for 1M; NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -22.92% | 1M: -40.85%), MSFT BELOW TREND (1W: -7.33% | 1M: -6.84%) and GOOGL BELOW TREND (1W: -10.31% | 1M: -18.18%). Member-level positive-stock breadth was not supplied; the sector is negative and overall breadth is 0/11.

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Financials are weak: sector returns are -7.55% for 1W and -5.60% for 1M; JPM BELOW TREND (1W: -10.30% | 1M: -7.73%) and V BELOW TREND (1W: -5.61% | 1M: -2.83%). Member-level positive-stock breadth was not supplied, and the sector’s aggregate returns confirm weakness.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Healthcare is under pressure, at -6.11% for 1W and -3.79% for 1M; UNH BELOW TREND (1W: -16.59% | 1M: -20.03%), while LLY is in CORRECTION (1W: -6.68% | 1M: +3.22%). Member-level positive-stock breadth was not supplied; defensive characteristics have not prevented the sector’s weekly decline.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Maintain a defensive, selective stance within the supplied RISK-OFF regime; favor relative resilience in Staples and Utilities while reducing exposure to the weakest Technology and Materials names. Style mixed / no clear leadership: sector breadth is uniformly negative, so neither Growth nor Value has broad confirmation.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Monitor PANW RECOVERY (1W: +6.54% | 1M: -3.27%) for follow-through; TGT ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.71% | 1M: +5.62%) for continued relative resilience. BEARISH: Watch NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -22.92% | 1M: -40.85%) and UNH BELOW TREND (1W: -16.59% | 1M: -20.03%) for stabilization or further deterioration.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Consumer Staples and Communication are relative leaders, but remain negative at -2.73% and -2.71% for 1W; overall breadth is 0/11. BEARISH: Technology (-13.10% 1W) and Materials (-8.11% 1W) show the deepest weakness; member-level sector breadth was not supplied.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
Absolute price levels were not provided, so no support or resistance prices can be stated without fabrication. Monitor whether PANW sustains its weekly rebound, whether NVDA stabilizes after its sharp 1W decline, and whether TGT holds its ABOVE TREND pattern.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
PANW (+45): Analyst price-target increase; RECOVERY (1W: +6.54% | 1M: -3.27%), so positive news and weekly price action confirm, while the 1M trend remains negative. LLY (+45): Analyst sees further upside; CORRECTION (1W: -6.68% | 1M: +3.22%), so the sentiment diverges from recent price action; other positive-sentiment names lack supplied 1W/1M returns for cross-reference.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
INTU (-65): Revenue guidance cut; BELOW TREND (1W: -20.85% | 1M: -23.80%), sentiment and price weakness confirm. UNH (-30): Government dispute over Medicare Advantage ratings; BELOW TREND (1W: -16.59% | 1M: -20.03%), and NEM (-35): gold-miner weakness as bullion slides; BELOW TREND (1W: -16.32% | 1M: -17.03%); both confirm negative sentiment with price weakness.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-OFF remains the supplied regime, with 0/11 sectors positive and no confirmed Growth-versus-Value leadership. Relative strength is concentrated in TGT ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.71% | 1M: +5.62%) and KHC ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.12% | 1M: +1.20%), while PANW is in RECOVERY (1W: +6.54% | 1M: -3.27%). Monitor broad Technology weakness and the divergence between positive PANW news and its negative 1M return.
